info.description: API for Alizzah School Management System
info.title: Alizzah Manajemen API

get.description: Get all academic years ordered by start_date descending

post.description: Create a new academic year (superadmin, admin_administrasi)

get.description: Get a single academic year's detail

patch.description: Set an academic year as active (deactivates all others)

post.description: Authenticate user with email and password, returns JWT token
Logout current user (client should discard the token)

get.description: Get the profile of the currently authenticated user
Get all class groups with optional filters

post.description: Create a new class group with schedule

get.description: Get a single class group's detail

delete.description: Delete a class group (fails if it still has active students)

post.description: Create a standalone guardian (unlinked to any student yet)

get.description: Get a single guardian's detail and their linked students

post.description: Create a new student with optional inline guardians
Import students from a CSV file

delete.description: Delete a student (fails if student has active enrollments)

get.description: List all guardians linked to a specific student

post.description: Link an existing guardian to a student
post.summary: Link a guardian to a student

delete.description: Remove the relationship between a guardian and a student (fails if it's the last guardian)
delete.summary: Unlink a guardian from a student

patch.description: Set a specific guardian as the primary guardian for a student

get.description: Get paginated list of users with optional search and role filter

delete.description: Soft delete a user (superadmin only, cannot delete self)

birth_date.description: Changed validation datetime format to custom
